issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Youkti
products.tagline: Finds who's ready to buy, then tells you what to do next
products.summaryZh: 找出谁已准备好购买，然后告诉你下一步该怎么做
products.descriptionZh: Youkti 记住每一个客户、对话和交易，然后告诉你的销售团队下一步该做什么：哪笔交易正在滑单，哪个沉睡客户刚刚发出信号，明天的会议要准备什么。专为 AE、RevOps 和外呼代表打造。联系人数据、购买信号和意向全部免费，无需信用卡，无计量收费。
products.description: Youkti keeps a memory of every account, conversation, and deal, then tells your sales team the exact next move: which deal is slipping, which dormant account just fired a signal, what to prep for tomorrow's meeting. Built for AEs, RevOps, and outbound reps. Contact data, buying signals, and intent are all free, no card, no meter.

products.name: Cortex
products.tagline: Turn API specs into docs, SDKs, and MCP servers
products.summaryZh: 将API规范转化为文档、SDK和MCP服务器
products.descriptionZh: Cortex 是一个开源 API 知识层，可将 OpenAPI、AsyncAPI、GraphQL、gRPC 和 OpenRPC 规范转化为交互式文档、11 种语言的类型化 SDK，以及面向 AI 智能体的 MCP 服务器。
products.description: Cortex is an open source API knowledge layer that turns OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, gRPC, and OpenRPC specs into interactive documentation, typed SDKs in 11 languages, and MCP servers for AI agents.

products.name: QApilot MCP for Android
products.tagline: Android app testing inside your coding agent
products.summaryZh: 在编码代理中测试Android应用
products.descriptionZh: QApilot MCP 通过与 Claude、Cursor 或 Codex 对话，在真实 Android 设备和模拟器上自动执行测试。用平实的英语描述测试流程，无需编写 Appium 代码。你的智能体规划步骤，QApilot 执行步骤。它会查找元素、等待屏幕稳定、在元素移动时重试，并缓存已学习的内容，从而加快重复运行的速度。每次通过都会保存一个 Gherkin 特性文件，并成为一个可重放的测试用例。需要 Node、Java 和 Android SDK。
products.description: QApilot MCP automates tests on real Android devices and emulators by talking to Claude, Cursor or Codex. Describe a test flow in plain English, no Appium code required. Your agent lays out the steps. QApilot runs the steps. It finds the elements, waits for the screen to settle, retries when something moves, and caches what it learns so repeat runs are faster. Every pass saves a Gherkin feature file and becomes a replayable test case. Needs Node, Java and the Android SDK.

products.name: ABrush
products.tagline: AI Studio for Digital Artists
products.summaryZh: 面向数字艺术家的AI工作室
products.descriptionZh: ABrush将领先的AI模型和可直接用于生产的先进AI工作流带入艺术家们已经熟悉的工作环境。我们利用AI消除重复性的生产工作，加速迭代，让艺术家有更多时间进行创意决策，同时确保艺术家对最终结果的控制权。AI加速流程并降低日常工作的成本。由艺术家创造，为艺术家服务。
products.description: ABrush brings leading AI models and production-ready advanced AI workflows into the environment where artists already work. We use AI to remove repetitive production work, accelerate iteration, and give artists more time for creative decisions, while keeping the artist in control of the final result. AI speeds up the process and cuts the cost of routine. Created by artists, for artists.

products.name: Calerto for Mac
products.tagline: Full-screen meeting alerts for your Mac
products.summaryZh: Mac 全屏会议提醒
products.descriptionZh: Calerto 把你的日历变成无法睡过的闹钟。全屏会议提醒——不是那种随手划掉的普通通知——可为每个会议自定义准备时间，支持 Apple 和 Google 日历同步，菜单栏倒计时显示下一项日程，登录时自动启动（随时可关闭）。暂停闹钟不会丢失。Pro 版可为整周自动设置闹钟。你的日历数据永远不会离开你的设备。再也不会迟到。
products.description: Calerto turns your calendar into alarms you can't sleep through. Full-screen meeting alerts — not another notification you'll swipe away — with custom prep time per meeting, Apple + Google Calendar sync, a menu bar countdown to what's next, and automatic launch at login (toggle it off anytime). Pause alarms without losing them. Pro auto-alarms your whole week. Your calendar data never leaves your device. Never be late again.

products.name: DockFix 5.0
products.tagline: Replace the macOS Dock with one that is truly yours.
products.summaryZh: 用一个真正属于你的 Dock 替换 macOS Dock。
products.descriptionZh: 用一个真正属于你的程序坞替换 macOS 程序坞。自定义颜色、图标和动画，还有小组件、窗口预览和文件架。
products.description: Replace the macOS Dock with one that is truly yours. Custom colors, icons and animations, plus widgets, window previews and a file shelf.

products.name: Wokyintosh
products.tagline: Turn a spare Mac display into a retro system dashboard!
products.summaryZh: 把闲置的Mac显示器变成复古系统仪表盘！
products.descriptionZh: Wokyintosh 是一款免费、开源的 macOS 仪表盘，灵感来自经典 Macintosh。它集成了大时钟和日期、本地天气、Apple Music 和 Spotify 的正在播放及封面，以及实时的 CPU、内存、固态硬盘和网络状态。我是在为我的 Wokyis M5 Retro Dock Station 寻找理想仪表盘数月无果后——即便在付费应用里也没找到——才动手做了它。
products.description: Wokyintosh is a free, open-source macOS dashboard inspired by the classic Macintosh. It combines a large clock and date, local weather, Apple Music and Spotify Now Playing with artwork, plus live CPU, RAM, SSD and network stats. I built it for my Wokyis M5 Retro Dock Station after months of not finding the dashboard I wanted — even among paid apps.

products.name: Stackness
products.tagline: Show your stack! The social home for your dev tools
products.summaryZh: 展示你的技术栈！开发工具们的社交家园
products.descriptionZh: Stackness 是开发者和 vibe coder 展示他们所用工具、工作流和方法的地方。创建一个技术栈档案，用一个链接分享，发布你的动态，关注你信任其品味的人，看工具起起落落。免费，并配有 MCP 服务器。
products.description: Stackness is where developers and vibe coders show the tools, workflows, and approaches they build with. Build a stack profile you share as one link, post your moves, follow people whose taste you trust, and watch tools rise and fall. Free and with an MCP server.

products.name: Relic
products.tagline: A private, synced vault of everything you copy
products.summaryZh: 一个私密、同步的剪贴板内容库
products.descriptionZh: Relic 会记住你复制的所有内容，在设备上理解它们，并在你的手机和电脑之间同步，全程加密，只有你能读取。保存你想日后更轻松找到的内容，用快捷键随时调出，无需离开键盘。适用于文件、图片、文本片段，以及任何在你的工作环境中可能无处安放的东西。
products.description: Relic remembers everything you copy, understands it on-device, and syncs it across your phones and computers, sealed so only you can read it. Save things you want to find more easily later, and bring them up with a hotkey without leaving your keyboard. Works with files, images, text snippets, and anything that might not have a home in your setup.

products.name: Work Life Panda
products.tagline: Every task, every calendar, one app. Private on-device AI
products.summaryZh: 每个任务、每个日历，一个应用。设备端私密AI
products.descriptionZh: 你的一周在日历里，待办在清单里，计划在群聊里。Work Life Panda 把它们汇聚到一个安静的地方——真正的任务管理器与真正的日历合二为一，从你已有的生活开始。每项任务和事件都有自己的聊天。
products.description: Your week lives in a calendar, your to-dos in a list, your plans in a group chat. Work Life Panda puts them in one calm place — a real task manager and real calendar, together, starting with the life you already have. Every task and event has its own chat.

products.name: VoxelWall
products.tagline: Music-reactive live wallpapers for Mac
products.summaryZh: 适用于 Mac 的音乐响应式动态壁纸
products.descriptionZh: VoxelWall 是一款原生 macOS 动态壁纸引擎，内置 37 个原创场景，可实时响应 Mac 上正在播放的任何内容。它在本地分析系统音频，并通过 Metal 实时渲染每个场景，而非循环播放视频。它适用于 Spotify、Apple Music、YouTube、浏览器和本地音频，并提供桌面、锁屏和节能模式。
products.description: VoxelWall is a native macOS live wallpaper engine with 37 original scenes that react in real time to whatever your Mac is playing. It analyzes system audio locally and renders each scene live with Metal — not as a repeating video. It works with Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, browsers and local audio, with Desktop, Lock Screen and Energy Saver modes.

products.name: Captain Kill Switch
products.tagline: Close all your open apps in one click
products.summaryZh: 一键关闭所有打开的应用程序
products.descriptionZh: 一个安静的程序坞按钮，在你需要清空一切时，即刻关闭所有正在运行的应用。免费、私密，跨平台支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。
products.description: A quiet menu-bar button that closes every running app the moment you need a clean slate. Free, private, and cross-platform for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

products.name: Pascal’s Pager
products.tagline: Turn webhook JSON into readable iPhone push notifications
products.summaryZh: 将 webhook JSON 转换为易读的 iPhone 推送通知
products.descriptionZh: 别再为每个服务写解析器。Pascal's Pager 利用 AI 将原始 webhook JSON 转换为清晰的 iPhone 提醒。为每个服务分配一个私有 URL，告诉 Pascal 哪些内容重要，即可获得包含关键事实和实用链接的摘要。在 AI 处理前屏蔽敏感字段，对相关 webhook 进行分组，并可查看 30 天内处理过的负载。专为独立开发者、副业项目和家庭服务器打造。
products.description: Stop writing a parser for every service. Pascal’s Pager uses AI to turn raw webhook JSON into clear iPhone Alerts. Give each service a private URL, tell Pascal what matters, and get a summary with key facts and useful links. Mask sensitive fields before AI processing, group related webhooks, and inspect the processed payloads for 30 days. Built for indie developers, side projects and home servers.

products.name: LinkFlick
products.tagline: Stop re-pairing your Magic Keyboard between Macs
products.summaryZh: 不必在Mac之间反复重新配对妙控键盘
products.descriptionZh: 我做这个是因为我受够了每次在MacBook和工作用的MacBook之间切换时都要重新配对Magic Keyboard和Mouse——两者Apple ID不同，Universal Control根本用不了。LinkFlick只是通过蓝牙把它们切过去。按快捷键，或者对Siri说“flick devices”，搞定。菜单栏应用，可自定义快捷键，还会在Magic Mouse电量耗尽前提醒你。有些地方还比较粗糙，但它能用，而且是我的。
products.description: I built this because I got sick of re-pairing my Magic Keyboard and Mouse every time I moved between my MacBook and my work MacBook — different Apple IDs, so Universal Control was never going to work for me. LinkFlick just flicks them over Bluetooth instead. Hotkey, or tell Siri "flick devices," done. Menu bar app, customizable hotkey, and it nags you before your Magic Mouse battery dies. Still rough around the edges in places, but it works, and it's mine.

products.name: SUDARI
products.tagline: A pixel otter desktop pet that reacts to how you work
products.summaryZh: 一只像素水獭桌面宠物，会根据你的工作方式做出反应
products.descriptionZh: 认识 Sudari 🦦 一只小小的像素水獭，搬进你的桌面，绝不甘于无聊。👀 跟随你的光标，还会真的眨眼 ⌨️ 你打字时，它会敲打一只迷你键盘 🐚 你滚动页面时，它会敲开贝壳 ⏱️ 贝壳造型的番茄钟，带烟花效果 💧 提醒你喝水、伸展、吃饭 🤖 你的 AI 智能体完成任务时，它会欢呼 💕 时不时说一句“我爱你” 17 个手工动画 · 8 种毛色 · 12 种语言 · 支持 Windows 和 Mac 免费且开源。无需账号，无遥测。只是一只水獭。
products.description: Meet Sudari 🦦 a tiny pixel otter who moves onto your desktop and refuses to be boring. 👀 Follows your cursor and blinks for real ⌨️ Kneads a tiny keyboard while you type 🐚 Cracks a shell when you scroll ⏱️ Shell-shaped Pomodoro with fireworks 💧 Nudges you to drink, stretch and eat 🤖 Cheers when your AI agent finishes 💕 Says "I love you" now and then 17 hand-made animations · 8 fur colors · 12 languages · Windows & Mac Free & open source. No account, no telemetry. Just an otter.

products.name: FrameSketch
products.tagline: Scrub vids frame-by-frame and sketch on them at 60fps
products.summaryZh: 逐帧浏览视频，并以60fps在其上绘制草图
products.descriptionZh: 拖入任意视频，逐帧拖动，直接在画布上以60fps绘制草图。零云端上传，100%客户端隐私，专为动画师、视觉特效师和动态设计师打造。
products.description: Drop any video in, scrub frame-by-frame, and sketch directly over the canvas at 60fps. Zero cloud uploads, 100% client-side privacy, and built for animators, VFX artists, and motion designers.

products.name: Coldlineai
products.tagline: Turn cold prospects into hot leads with AI-powered pitches
products.summaryZh: 用AI驱动的推介将冷淡潜在客户转化为热门线索
products.descriptionZh: ColdLine.ai 借助 AI 驱动的个性化推介，帮你把冷线索转化为热潜在客户。只需添加潜在客户的信息，ColdLine.ai 便能在几秒内生成贴合场景、听起来像真人撰写的推介内容。节省时间、实现个性化触达、获得更多回复——无需从零撰写每一条消息。非常适合创始人、销售团队、营销人员、招聘人员和代理机构。
products.description: ColdLine.ai helps you turn cold prospects into hot leads with AI-powered personalized pitches. Simply add your prospect’s details, and ColdLine.ai creates a relevant, human-sounding pitch in seconds. Save time, personalize your outreach, and get more replies—without writing every message from scratch. Perfect for founders, sales teams, marketers, recruiters, and agencies.

products.name: Kabza
products.tagline: Take over a real city map with your friends
products.summaryZh: 与好友一起接管真实城市地图
products.descriptionZh: 把诺伊达、德里、古尔冈或班加罗尔变成与朋友的战场。拖动即可派出支持者，占领地盘，控制75%的地图即可获胜。可单人对抗机器人，也可在最多8人的房间中对战。浏览器中免费畅玩，无需下载或注册账号。
products.description: Turn Noida, Delhi, Gurugram or Bengaluru into a battle with friends. Drag to send supporters, capture territory and hold 75% of the map to win. Play solo against bots or in a room of up to 8. Free in your browser. No download or account needed.

products.name: Marked Share
products.tagline: Markdown and TextBundle editing, review, and sharing
products.summaryZh: Markdown 和 TextBundle 的编辑、审阅与共享
products.descriptionZh: Marked Share 是 Marked 3 的子产品，但使用它无需安装 Marked。这是一种免费分享 Markdown 和 TextBundle 文档（含图片和附件）的方式，允许他人高亮和评论，甚至能发布带有 RSS/Atom 和 Micro.blog 集成的“博客”订阅源。内置编辑器，或提供完整 API 以便与你喜欢的编辑器/工具集成。
products.description: Marked Share is a subproduct of Marked 3, but doesn't require Marked to use. It's a free way to share Markdown and TextBundle documents with images and attachments, allow others to highlight and comment on them, and can even publish "blog" feeds with RSS/Atom and Micro.blog integration. Built in editor, or a full API for integrating with your favorite editor/tool.

products.name: Duos 2.0
products.tagline: Stop guessing why you're not getting hired
products.summaryZh: 别再猜测自己为什么没被录用
products.descriptionZh: 面试是一场有潜规则的社交游戏，评分者从不解释打分依据。Duos 就是排练场。粘贴职位描述，戴上耳机。与读过你简历的面试官交谈，在对话中随时改变策略，享受揣摩他们的乐趣。面试、复盘、重复，直到你准备就绪。内里是引以为傲的过度设计多智能体架构。
products.description: Interviewing is a social game with unwritten rules, scored by people who never explain the score. Duos is the rehearsal. Paste a job posting and put on headphones. Talk to interviewers who've read your CV, change tactics mid-convo, and are fun to figure out. Interview, debrief, repeat until you're ready. Proudly over-engineered multi-agent stack inside.
